title: Streamgraph
intent: Show the changing composition of unemployment across every industry with a wiggle baseline and inside-out layer order.

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC streamgraph from the industries dataset's original date, industry, and unemployed fields using a wiggle baseline and inside-out order in both Plot and granular d3-shape preparation.
ai.maintain: Change the stack order or offset while retaining industry identity, explicit y1/y2 intervals, equivalent zero-shift semantics, and the untouched imported rows.
